purpose: Shows a translated pending label with decorative settling grains while an action completes.

notes: Pass the application's translated pending label as children; direction follows surrounding layout or VeliProvider.

useWhen: A short label can explain what is pending.
Decorative settling grains should replace a typed ellipsis.

avoidWhen.situation: Only an indeterminate icon is needed without explanatory text.
The layout shape should be reserved while concrete UI is loading.

approvedPatterns: Pass a complete translated pending label without a trailing ellipsis.
Reuse LoadingText beside Spinner when both indicator and label are useful.
Hide the component with aria-hidden when a parent already announces status.
limitations: Children must be a string label.
LoadingText does not disable surrounding controls by itself.
accessibility: Defaults to role status and uses the full label as the accessible name.
Animated grains are hidden from assistive technology.
Reduced motion stops the light band and grain movement while keeping a gentle opacity pulse.
rtl: The settling light band follows the active text direction.
